reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E2 describes a different alloy system where protective Al2O3/Cr2O3 scales were not continuous and oxidation resistance relied on CrTaO4, not sluggish diffusion. E3 tests corrosion in molten salt, not high-temperature oxidation, and explicitly questions whether sluggish diffusion exists. The core mechanistic claims about diffusion-controlled oxide formation in CoCrFeMnNi-Al are unsupported by the provided passages.
